steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each failure mode of a critical asset is matched to a maintenance response and to its record count.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 failure mode has no maintenance response

findings.title: Failure mode with no maintenance response
findings.fix: Set a response for the failure mode

findings.title: Count does not match the records
Critical asset with no failure analysis

outcome.notChecked: Causes that need a physical check.
